description:
Faction Mission Blacklist
Stops vanilla delivery missions from always sending you to boss factions.
Type: Utility / QoL — completely safe to add to or remove from a save at any time.

Release page: v1.0.0 | Source: GitHub

The problem
Boss factions like Adversary and Hivers are hostile to almost everyone, so their markets are always short on goods. The vanilla "deliver X to Y" bar event favors the biggest shortages, so nearly every delivery offer ends up pointing at a market you can't or don't want to go to:

What this does
Vanilla already has an "invalid mission target" flag on markets that missions skip; mods just rarely set it. This mod:

sets it on every market owned by a blacklisted faction
re-checks once per in-game day, so new or conquered markets are covered
clears it again if a market it flagged changes hands to a normal faction
removes all its flags right before the game saves and restores them right after, so nothing from this mod is ever stored in your save

Other vanilla missions that check the same flag will also skip those factions. The factions' own content is unaffected.

Default blacklist: Adversary (adversary), Hiver (HIVER). Factions you don't have installed are ignored.

Adding factions: add the faction ID to data/config/settings.json. IDs are the file names in a mod's data/world/factions/ folder, or use "list factions" with Console Commands.
Mod authors: you can blacklist your own boss faction from your mod's settings.json under the key factionMissionBlacklist_factions; Starsector merges the lists.

Installation: extract into Starsector/mods/ and enable in the launcher.
Save compatible: Utility mod. Add it to or remove it from a save at any time: nothing from the mod is written into your save file, so removing it leaves the save exactly as if it had never been installed. Existing offers keep their destination; new ones are filtered. No dependencies.

License: MIT, feel free to include it in your own mod or modpack.

(Not affiliated with the Adversary or Hivers mods; no files from either mod are included.)

AI Use Disclaimer: Code by Claude (Anthropic)

Suggestions for other boss factions to add to the default blacklist are welcome!

discordPostHtml:
Tired of "Nod to the concerned man" delivery contracts at the bar always sending you to Adversary or Hiver markets? This blacklists boss factions as delivery mission destinations, so the bar event picks normal markets instead.

Default blacklist: Adversary, Hiver. Add more factions in data/config/settings.json.

Added - Mod
Save Compatibility: safe to add or remove at any time.

Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=36239.0
aiDescription: Automatically flags markets belonging to blacklisted factions as invalid mission targets. This stops vanilla delivery contracts from directing players to unreachable or undesirable boss faction markets. The blacklist is configurable via a JSON file, and the mod ensures no data is written to save files.
